subject.title: feat(workboard): review gate hard blocks + workboard_submit_review tool

question: Should Workboard introduce a durable `ready_to_merge` status and fail-closed completion gate as the permanent review lifecycle, or should the review gate be modeled with existing statuses/contracts?
rationale: The code defects are repairable, but choosing a new persisted status and making completion fail closed can affect existing Workboard users and needs owner intent before merge.

options.title: Repair and keep the review lifecycle
options.body: Preserve existing tool envelopes, require passed review proof for completion, declare the review tool/status everywhere, add tests/docs, and require real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Avoid a new durable status
options.body: Redesign the review gate around existing `review`/`done` states and proof records if maintainers do not want `ready_to_merge` stored in Workboard state.

options.title: Pause the PR for owner design
options.body: Leave the branch open but blocked until a Workboard owner confirms the lifecycle contract and upgrade behavior.

recommendation.title: Repair and keep the review lifecycle
recommendation.body: Preserve existing tool envelopes, require passed review proof for completion, declare the review tool/status everywhere, add tests/docs, and require real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc is the clearest available owner from Workboard introduction history and was also mentioned in the PR timeline after the first review.
